scope: Cumulative local acceptance of the complete MJ-REQ-189 Jobs search-filter workflow across connected controls, API predicates, profile-scoped saved searches, result ordering/limits, and separate application-route and source evidence.
acceptance: The connected Jobs UI exposes keyword, title, company, location, remote type, salary bounds, experience, posted-date, employment type, skill, education, clearance, minimum match score, source, ATS, application-link availability, user-reported application state, and recorded application capability filters.

Composed criteria filter before result limits where applicable, preserve unknown/missing evidence semantics, and keep collection source, route provider, verified ATS, and application capability distinct.
Saved searches persist and restore criteria for the owning profile; users can clear live criteria; legacy payloads remain compatible; cross-profile reads and selections do not leak saved searches.
Invalid and unknown saved filters fail closed; application status filters use only user-reported pipeline events and never infer employer receipt or internal application state.
Connected synthetic browser workflows observed no external requests, source scheduling/collection, application mutations, or submissions.

checks.evidence: 1 connected Chromium workflow passed in 10.17s, combining all baseline filter fields, saved-search restore and clear, result checks, and profile isolation.
TypeScript/Vite production build passed; existing 750.46 kB chunk-size advisory remains.
